# ArchiDiagram

> ArchiDiagram provides professional SketchUp plugins, presentation templates, and tutorials for architects and design students to create stunning architectural diagrams and site analysis.

## Key Plugins & Tools
- **Sun Diagram**: 3D Sun Path & Solar Analysis Plugin for SketchUp.
- **Dynamic Symbols**: Animated SketchUp components (GIF/MP4) for architectural presentation.
- **Shadow Slice**: Automated section cut shadows for SketchUp.
